ValeeraVigor.name: Vigor
ValeeraVigor.description: Valeera regenerates an additional 3 Energy per second. Reward: After Gathering 20 Regen Globes, increase Valeera's maximum Energy to 120.

ValeeraVanishSubtlety.name: Subtlety
ValeeraVanishSubtlety.description: After teleporting with Ambush, Cheap Shot, or Garrote, regenerate 10 Energy per second for 5 seconds.

ValeeraCombatReadiness.name: Combat Readiness
ValeeraCombatReadiness.description: Each Combo Point spent grants 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

ValeeraCripplingPoison.name: Crippling Poison
ValeeraCripplingPoison.description: Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds Slow targets by 20% for 4 seconds. Activating Crippling Poison does not break Stealth.

ValeeraSinisterStrikeRelentlessStrikes.name: Relentless Strikes
ValeeraSinisterStrikeRelentlessStrikes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of Sinister Strike by 10.

ValeeraGarroteHemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
ValeeraGarroteHemorrhage.description: Valeera's Basic Attacks deal 40% additional damage to enemies affected by Garrote.

ValeeraVanishInitiative.name: Initiative
ValeeraVanishInitiative.description: Ambush, Cheap Shot, and Garrote grant 15% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and award 2 Combo Points.

ValeeraWoundPoison.name: Wound Poison
ValeeraWoundPoison.description: Activate to make Valeera's next damaging Ability and subsequent Abilities within 4 seconds reduce enemy healing received by 50% for 4 seconds. Activating Wound Poison does not break Stealth.

ValeeraSinisterStrikeMutilate.name: Mutilate
ValeeraSinisterStrikeMutilate.description: Sinister Strike now hits with both blades, dealing 125% additional damage, but its range is reduced by 1.

ValeeraBladeFlurryFatalFinesse.name: Fatal Finesse
ValeeraBladeFlurryFatalFinesse.description: Quest: Each time Blade Flurry damages an enemy Hero, its damage increases by 6, up to 90. Reward: After damaging 15 Heroes with Blade Flurry, permanently reduce its Energy cost by 20.

ValeeraEviscerateSliceAndDice.name: Slice and Dice
ValeeraEviscerateSliceAndDice.description: Eviscerating an enemy with 3 Combo Points grants 150% Attack Speed. Lasts 3 seconds or 3 Basic Attacks. Passive: Basic Attacks restore 2 Energy.

ValeeraSmokeBomb.name: Smoke Bomb
ValeeraSmokeBomb.description: Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds. Using this Ability does not break Stealt

ValeeraCloakOfShadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
ValeeraCloakOfShadows.description: Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%. Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

ValeeraAmbushDeathFromAbove.name: Death From Above
ValeeraAmbushDeathFromAbove.description: Teleporting with Ambush reduces the cooldown of Vanish by 4 seconds.

ValeeraCheapShotBlind.name: Blind
ValeeraCheapShotBlind.description: Increase the duration of Cheap Shot's Blind by 2.5 seconds.

ValeeraGarroteStrangle.name: Strangle
ValeeraGarroteStrangle.description: Using Garrote on a Hero reduces their Spell Power by 40% for 6 seconds.

ValeeraSinisterStrikeSealFate.name: Seal Fate
ValeeraSinisterStrikeSealFate.description: Sinister Strike deals 50% additional damage and generates an additional Combo Point when used against Silenced, Rooted, or Stunned enemy Heroes.

ValeeraAmbushAssassinate.name: Assassinate
ValeeraAmbushAssassinate.description: Ambush deals 50% additional damage and reduces the target's Armor by an additional 10 if no other enemy Heroes are within 4 range of the victim.

ValeeraThistleTea.name: Thistle Tea
ValeeraThistleTea.description: Activate to instantly restore 100 Energy. Activating Thistle Tea does not break Stealth.

ValeeraSmokeBombAdrenalineRush.name: Adrenaline Rush
ValeeraSmokeBombAdrenalineRush.description: While in the Smoke Bomb, Valeera regenerates an additional 40 Energy per second.

ValeeraCloakOfShadowsEnvelopingShadows.name: Enveloping Shadows
ValeeraCloakOfShadowsEnvelopingShadows.description: Whenever Valeera uses Vanish, she also gains Cloak of Shadows.

ValeeraGarroteRupture.name: Rupture
ValeeraGarroteRupture.description: Increase Garrote's damage over time by 100%. Valeera's Basic Attacks refresh the duration of Garrote.

ValeeraVanishElusiveness.name: Elusiveness
ValeeraVanishElusiveness.description: Increases Valeera's Movement Speed while Vanished by an additional 20%.
